title: Wikipedia: Chevrolet Bolt
notes: First generation 2017-2023: 60 kWh (2017-19), 66 kWh (2020-23), nickel-rich lithium-ion, 55 kW SAE Combo DC (optional; standard from 2021 Premier and the 2022 refresh), onboard AC 7.2 kW rising to 11.5 kW with the 2022 refresh; EUV 65 kWh, 55 kW DC standard, 11.5 kW AC. 2027: 65 kWh LFP, 150 kW, port switched from CCS to NACS. Usable not stated.
